prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading and optimal energy for 20km long run

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact and fits within 1 day with realistic meal timing
Includes elevated caloric intake appropriate for endurance athlete (3000+ calories)
Strategically positions high-carbohydrate meals around training windows (pre/post workout)
Provides balanced macronutrients with emphasis on carbohydrates for glycogen loading
task_description: write a compact , concise 1 day meal plan for a single athelete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated caloric intake and carbohydrate loading with realistic meal timing around training windows

prompt_inputs.goal: muscle recovery and strength maintenance between two training sessions

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly one day with compact format (brief descriptions per meal)
Minimum 2.0g protein per kg bodyweight distributed across meals
Meals are light and digestible to minimize burden between training sessions
Includes specific food items rather than generic categories
task_description: write a compact , concise 1 day meal plan for a single athelete
